freeze_basis: The first Git commit containing this file is the candidate freeze. Sprint 1 control results are hypothesis-generation evidence only and cannot count as validation.

origin.selection_rule: All four reversed-control lookbacks were positive at 1.5x friction. The preregistered stable-neighborhood upper-median rule over [20,30,45,60] selects 45 days rather than the highest historical PnL at 60 days.

economic_hypothesis: Crypto altcoins with unusually positive daily returns relative to their recent BTC beta may exhibit short-horizon continuation rather than reversal, while unusually negative BTC-residual shocks may continue negatively over the next day.

universe.fixed_present_universe_warning: Survivorship bias remains unresolved; a broader point-in-time universe is a later research requirement.

signal.fit_window: strictly prior completed daily returns t-45 through t-1
signal.ranking: rank the nine alts by current completed-day residual
signal.direction: long highest residual two; short lowest residual two
signal.weights: equal dollar, +0.25 each long and -0.25 each short

execution.decision_time: after daily candle t is complete
execution.rebalance: daily at open using the signal from the prior completed daily candle
execution.position_transition_costing: 10 bps per side on actual portfolio turnover

controls.principal_reversed_control: same timing and residual ranks but long lowest residual and short highest residual
controls.raw_return_momentum_control: same timing using raw alt daily return ranks without BTC-beta residualization

evidence_boundary.next_allowed_historical_test: D2 independent source with exact frozen rule and no retuning
evidence_boundary.future_prospective_evidence: D4 begins only after this freeze commit for a separately configured shadow

replication_gates.independent_source: Binance USD-M perpetuals where exact symbols and timestamps are available
